intro.text: The lawless, thinly populated lands of southeastern Roshar, outside Alethkar's borders, which take the strongest highstorms on the continent.

description.text: The Frostlands lie closest to the Origin of the highstorms of any of the eastern stormlands.
Plants grow small there: rockbuds never get bigger than a fist or open fully, and grass grows in patches on the leeward side of rocks, with short, spiky blades.
